basis: Cardiac malformations occur in 30–79%; skeletal, CNS and renal anomalies are generally 5–29%; hearing loss and pigmentation changes are very rare.
Overgrowth of gingival tissue; gums belong to the gastrointestinal axis.
Loss of urethral sphincter function; the renal axis includes the urethra.
Severe neurodevelopmental disorder with epilepsy and brain atrophy; sensorineural hearing impairment in 2/6 patients (~33%).
Retinal dystrophy, obesity and digital malformations define BBS; developmental delay 2/2 and intellectual disability 2/4. Renal insufficiency 1/3 omitted because of cap.
Severe congenital neutrophil deficiency is both a blood-cell disorder and an innate immunodeficiency; additional organ defects vary by subtype.
Ovarian endocrine failure with reduced estradiol and elevated gonadotropins; gonadal hormone dysfunction belongs to the endocrine axis.
Disorder of binocular visual correspondence and function.
Umbrella of inherited skeletal myopathies; cardiac and respiratory involvement vary by subtype and are not established in at least 30% across the group.
Isolated developmental eye malformation causing microphthalmia or anophthalmia and impaired vision.
Skeletal dysplasia with hormone resistance; developmental delay 2/2 and hearing impairment 1/2 in small cohorts. Unilateral renal agenesis 1/3 omitted because of cap.
Malignant adipose neoplasm arising in the breast; breast has no axis.
Inherited retinal degeneration with photoreceptor loss, night blindness and reduced visual acuity.
Direct neurotoxicity, acute kidney injury and interstitial pneumonitis are annotated at 30–79%; gastrointestinal symptoms and blood-pressure changes alone do not establish lasting organ damage.
Inborn metabolic disorder defined by neurological dysfunction; developmental delay in 80–99%. Cardiomyopathy occurs in only 5–29% across the umbrella.
Allergic occupational asthma causing immune-mediated airway inflammation and obstruction.
Isolated inherited cardiomyopathy with ventricular dilatation or noncompaction and heart failure.
CNS tumor arising from specialized ependymal cells in the pineal region; hydrocephalus and central visual disturbances do not establish intrinsic eye or endocrine disease.
Autoimmune Guillain-Barre variant directly damaging motor and sensory peripheral axons.
Degenerative contact of adjacent vertebral spinous processes with interspinous tissue disease.
Papillary urothelial carcinoma arising in the bladder or renal pelvis; both belong to the renal axis.
Vascular, skin and joint fragility; pulmonary damage supported by emphysema 8/9 and hemothorax 3/4 in small annotated cohorts. Bowel rupture, a major criterion, omitted at cap.
Neuroendocrine tumor arising in gastric mucosa; associated gastritis or MEN1 are separate conditions, and endocrine dysfunction is not defining.
Superficial dermal fibrous proliferation of digits; skin nodules are obligate, with frequent epidermal changes.
Carbon monoxide-related basal ganglia and cerebral white-matter injury causing parkinsonism and cognitive impairment.
